name: PC programming software
subtitle: Configurator & mini-USB lead for EVC Control units; allows the optional programming of extension names etc via a Windows PC
legacyName: PC programming software, configurator & mini-USB lead for EVC Control units (allows the optional programming of extension names etc via a Windows PC)
summary: The ECU423 is a Configuration Tools software for the Sigtel fire telephone system and disabled refuge system of Context Plus. Devices can be named/edited using the buttons on a master controller or via this ECU423 PC programming configurator.
features: Includes software CD, configurator and mini-USB to master controller connector leads.
Setup can be saved to, and from a PC.
Allows the programming of extension names, etc. via a Windows PC.
Configurator and mini-USB for the Sigtel master controllers ECU-4, ECU-8 and ECU-16.
